_about: A picture for each of the almanac's plants of the day, by Hone's Latin name: an old botanical plate, coloured and public domain, on Wikimedia Commons or the Biodiversity Heritage Library. Every one was looked at and is the plant named (by its current name, in "name"); null means looked and found no good one, and a plant not listed hasn't been looked at yet. "credit" is what the plate's own page says it's from. Candidates come from ktdi/tools/almanac_plates_find.py.
